global_objects: paired tile endpoints; Crossing.tile selected, Crossing.channel=-1 until final legalization
candidate_score: complete local hyperedge HPWL + weighted complete path timing + marginal tile density; no proposal displacement or switching penalty
x_initialization: newborn crossings seed nearest feasible source-side entry X; subsequent complete-cost tile updates may change columns
y: both paired endpoints and all incident local trees; subsequent crossings included after tree construction
qp: existing real/virtual wire and timing couplings preserved; additional kappa density-target feedback remains 0.05
global_timing: conservative per-tile envelope over unreserved channel timing models; no lane preference
capacity: 24 canonical channels per full U250 tile pair; opposing directions share capacity; count crossing once
finalization: refresh final cells, score tiles, then assign exact channels with access-footprint checks and bounded search within each tile pair; fail before export if unresolved
limitations: Final exact legalization may fail despite aggregate tile capacity. Search is bounded and does not prove infeasibility.
Enumerating all tile positions is not yet benchmarked on a large design.
